close_reason: Added comment documenting duplicate-OID invariant in names_match
description: The names_match function relies on RFC 5280 SET semantics to forbid duplicate OIDs within an RDN, but this constraint is not documented anywhere. A maintainer unfamiliar with X.509 could refactor the matching logic to use pair-tracking without realizing it would break on edge case certificates with same OID repeated. Document this invariant in the names_match rustdoc or add an assertion/validation check.
title: SET matching: document duplicate OID invariant in names_match
